create_collider_decorator: create a collider decorator that wraps collision functions for use by the collision driver with configurable ncon
run_sphere_ellipsoid_collision: run sphere to ellipsoid collision detection using SDF-based optimization and gradient descent
run_capsule_cylinder_collision: run capsule to cylinder collision detection returning up to 2 contact pairs via vmap
run_cylinder_cylinder_collision: run cylinder to cylinder collision detection returning up to 4 contact pairs via vmap
build_sdf_collision_functions: build signed distance function collision functions for sphere, capsule, ellipsoid, and cylinder shapes
